text_block_list.text:
The final day of summer camp. At Satono 
Crown's request, we decided to hold a 
joint training session.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!! Yaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*, I'm so exhaausted~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Cheval didn't slow down at all right until 
the very end—I'm truly impressed.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N... Not at all... At the end, it was pure 
willpower... really...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
No need for modesty. Haven't you built up 
even more stamina over this summer?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
There really are some "aptitudes" that 
effort alone just can't make up for. You 
seem built for long distances through and 
through!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I've finally made up my 
mind. It's all thanks to the "mirror" that 
is you!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um... Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You know, I was conflicted for the longest 
time. Wondering which yellow flower I was 
supposed to be aiming for...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Still, today's training run confirmed it 
for me— I... will not be heading to the 
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka-sho is 3,000 meters long—the 
longest among the GⅠ races open to 
Classic-tier runners.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Even if I were to challenge that with my 
poor long-distance aptitude, it would be 
difficult to claim the Kikuka's glory."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll choose another path where I can 
make the most of myself. ...What will you 
do, Cheval?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh... M-Me...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You're thinking about the fall races, 
right? I hope you can weigh your options 
against me and everyone else and choose a 
good path.

The next morning. While waiting for the 
bus back to the academy, I decided to ask 
Cheval Grand and Shine Praise.
choice_data_list:
How was summer training camp for the two 
of you?

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, it was really fulfilling. I 
got to run with Cheval-chan a lot, and I 
think I grew from it.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um, I think... I gave it my all, too!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, compared to everyone else, I 
might be nowhere close... but still—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: No... umm...—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Maybe I don't need to go out of my way to 
say it... Still, I feel like I understand 
a little better now...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sure— I can't just keep looking at 
myself...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Because I had no idea at all... About 
Kita-san's struggles, so similar to mine—)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Cheval-chan... I just realized 
something...—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"If only we were in different 
generations—" he said.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If only Duramente-san wasn't around, maybe 
an ordinary girl like me could have shone 
a little—!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(The fact that Crown-san... saw me as a 
rival, too—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
For instance, her long-lasting kick and 
steady race management. Not to mention her 
earnest personality that allows her to 
steadily build up stamina.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You found that kind of "strength" by 
comparing yourself to your older sisters.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I decided to look at you too. 
At you—and at myself."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(All this time, I only looked at others to 
dwell on my own shortcomings...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Still... if I truly want to become a 
"great Umamusume," this surely won't cut 
it...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Because everyone worries... and compares 
themselves to others...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, because I properly found my 
strengths rather than just focusing on 
where I fell short――)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(If that is what it truly means to know 
oneself――)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... um, ...well.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I felt... like I need to look outside a 
bit more too...

I couldn't grasp her exact intentions, but 
I felt she had become just a little more 
positive.

"This change might lead to a huge step 
forward. That was what I found myself 
thinking—"
